name: site-admin
description: The same /admin on every one of your websites: per-person sign-in with roles, resets, throttling and an activity log; analytics with graphs; an inbox for every form with editable recipients and a Responded checkbox; a Setup tab that connects Stripe, email, MailerLite and spam protection from inside the admin with live checks; an (i) with step-by-step help on every tab; plus people, a tab per product, course progress, calendar, affiliates, Stripe codes and links, sending documents, and MailerLite groups where a site needs them. Ships a tested kit for Cloudflare Pages on D1 or Supabase, and notes for KV and Next.js.
